_comment: Limits for mogzy-guard, which only serializes BROAD jobs. Targeted test runs (<= 8 named test files, scope.mjs) never use it. No value here can refuse a job: League, Firefox, RAM and CPU only shrink it (workers, priority). See README 'Tuning'.

resources._comment: Advisory only. Below advisoryFreeRamMB (+ class estimate) the job runs with 1 worker; above advisoryCpuPercent a note is printed.

_heavyProcessComment: Command-line patterns used only by 'status' (and an advisory note) to list test/build processes running outside the guard. They never block anything: targeted runs from other sessions are expected to appear here.
